source: Rule of the Congregation (1QSa), Qumran -- unreviewed machine-draft translation, Open Dead Sea (opendeadsea.org, CC BY-NC 4.0)

1.1: And this is the high official for all the congregation of Israel in the end of the days in the gathering to walk
1.2: Upon the mouth of justice of the sons of Zadok the priests and the men of their covenant who turned aside from walking in the way
1.3: The people, they are the men whose counsel, who observed the covenant in the midst of guilt to cover the distance of the earth.
1.4: When they come, they will assemble all the people, from the youngest to the women, and they will proclaim in their ears.
1.5: and all the statutes of the covenant and to understand in all their judgments, lest they err in their mistakes
1.6: And this the high official to all the host of the gathering to every (the) native-born in Israel. And from the youth
1.7: To learn in the letter of the pronunciation and as the mouths of their days they will prosper in the statutes of the covenant and to take
1.8: Chastening in their justice: ten years come in the child and a son of twenty year[s]
1.9: Upon the appointed to come in the lot within the clan to the gathering in the holiness and not he shall approach
1.10: To a woman to know to lying of a male if to mouth he has fulfilled of twenty year[s] in know[ing] good
1.11: And evil. And thus she will receive to warn upon the judgments of the instruction and to stand in the rumor of judgments.
1.12: And in the filling of it, a son of five and twenty years will come to stand in the foundations of the congregation.
1.13: The holiness to serve the service of the congregation. And a son of thirty years will approach to conduct a case.
1.14: And of justice to stand in the heads of the families of Israel to leaders of hundreds leaders
1.15: Leaders of tens, judges and officers for their tribes in all their clans upon the mouth of their sons
1.16: Aaron the priests and all the heads of the fathers of the congregation which came out the lot to stand in service
1.17: To go out and to come before the congregation. And to the mouth of his insight with the completeness of his way, he will be strong in his hips to stand and serve.
1.18: The work of deeds in the midst of brothers, in interval of multitude to little, this upon this, they will honor each from neighbor.
1.19: And in the multiplying of years to the mouth of strength they will give the burden of the work of the gathering and all the men of simplicity
1.20: Not shall come in lot to stand upon the congregation of Israel to the law-case of justice and to carry a burden of the congregation
1.21: And to stand in war to humble nations. Only in your high official the service writes his clan.
1.22: And in the work of the forced labour which he makes as his deed. And the descendants of Levi shall stand, a man in his standing.
1.23: Upon the mouth of the sons of Aaron to bring and to lead out all the congregation, a man in his high official position, upon the hand of the heads
1.24: The gathering to the chiefs and to the judges and to the officers to the number of all their hosts upon the mouth of the sons of Zadok the priests
1.25: And all the heads of the fathers of the congregation, and if there be an attestation to all the assembly for justice or
1.26: to my counsel, gathering or to attestation of war and they were holy, three days to be all the one who comes
1.27: When ready to they the men called to the counsel of the gathering from a son of twenty whole
1.28: The wise, the witness, and the understanding, and the knowing, the complete of the way, and the men of strength
1.29: The chiefs of the rods and all judges and their officers and the commanders of the thousands and chiefs of the hundreds

2.1: And to the fifties and to the tens and the Levites in their division, its work. These
2.2: The men, the name, summoned, the appointment, those appointed to the counsel of the gathering in Israel
2.3: Before the sons of Zadok the priests, and every man touched by one from all uncleanness(es)
2.4: The man must not come to the assembly of God. And all the men touched by these to not.
2.5: Maintain a stand in the midst of the congregation and all who are touched in his flesh, smitten in the feet, or
2.6: hands of a lame or blind or deaf or speechless or blemish touched in his flesh
2.7: To see eyes, or an old man stumbling, not to be strong among the congregation.
2.8: Not to them it will come to stand in the midst of the congregation of men the name that messengers
2.9: Holiness in their witness. And if there is a word to one of these to speak to the counsel of the holiness
2.10: And inquire from his mouth and to the midst of the congregation not he brought the man that touched
2.11: He, this is the seat of the men of the name, summoned to the appointment for the counsel of the gathering, if he bears
2.12: [God] the anointed ones. He will come, the priest, the head of all the congregation of Israel and all
2.13: The fathers the sons of Aaron the priests summoned of the appointment the men of the name and they sat
2.14: before his face everyone to the mouth of his weight and after the anointed of Israel they sat before his face heads
2.15: of the families of Israel each to the mouth of his weight as his standing in their camps and as their journeys and all
2.16: The heads of the fathers of the congregation with the wise ones of the holy congregation sat before them, each man to his mouth
2.17: His honor and if to the table of gathering they are appointed or to drink the wine and arrange the table
2.18: The gathering and mixing the wine to drink, he will not send a man with his hand in the beginning
2.19: The bread and the wine to the face of the priest. That he blessed the beginning of the bread.
2.20: And the wine they will send, and stretch out a hand on the bread before presence. And after he sends the anointed of Israel, his hand.
2.21: In bread. And after they bless all the congregation, each man to his mouth. And as this portion they do
2.22: to the whole row that they appoint unto ten men
